package lastfm

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"io/ioutil"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"net/url"
	"strings"

	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/model/request"
	"github.com/navidrome/navidrome/tests"
	. "github.com/onsi/ginkgo"
	. "github.com/onsi/gomega"
)

var _ = Describe("LastFM link routes", func() {
	It("binds callbacks, link status and unlink to the authenticated user", func() {
		ds := &tests.MockDataStore{}
		fake := &tests.FakeHttpClient{Res: http.Response{Body: ioutil.NopCloser(bytes.NewBufferString(`{"session":{"key":"SK-A"}}`)), StatusCode: 200}}
		router := &Router{ds: ds, sessionKeys: &sessionKeys{ds: ds}, client: NewClient("key", "secret", "en", fake)}
		ctxA := request.WithUser(context.Background(), model.User{ID: "user-a"})
		ctxB := request.WithUser(context.Background(), model.User{ID: "user-b"})
		Expect(ds.UserProps(ctxB).Put("user-b", sessionKeyProperty, "SK-B")).To(Succeed())

		start := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.startLink(start, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link/start", nil).WithContext(ctxA))
		Expect(start.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusOK))
		var response struct {
			State string `json:"state"`
		}
		Expect(json.Unmarshal(start.Body.Bytes(), &response)).To(Succeed())
		Expect(response.State).ToNot(BeEmpty())

		decoded, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(response.State)
		Expect(err).To(Succeed())
		tampered := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(strings.Replace(string(decoded), "user-a:", "user-b:", 1)))
		spoofed := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.callback(spoofed, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link/callback?token=token&state="+url.QueryEscape(tampered), nil))
		Expect(spoofed.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusBadRequest))
		Expect(fake.RequestCount).To(Equal(0))

		invalid := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.callback(invalid, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link/callback?uid=user-b&token=token", nil))
		Expect(invalid.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusBadRequest))
		Expect(fake.RequestCount).To(Equal(0))

		callback := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.callback(callback, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link/callback?token=token&state="+url.QueryEscape(response.State), nil))
		Expect(callback.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusOK))
		Expect(ds.UserProps(ctxB).Get("user-a", sessionKeyProperty)).To(Equal("SK-A"))
		Expect(ds.UserProps(ctxA).Get("user-b", sessionKeyProperty)).To(Equal("SK-B"))

		replay := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.callback(replay, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link/callback?token=token&state="+url.QueryEscape(response.State), nil))
		Expect(replay.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusBadRequest))
		Expect(fake.RequestCount).To(Equal(1))

		status := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.getLinkStatus(status, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/link", nil).WithContext(ctxB))
		Expect(status.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusOK))
		Expect(status.Body.String()).To(ContainSubstring(`"status":true`))

		unlink := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.unlink(unlink, httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodDelete, "/link", nil).WithContext(ctxA))
		Expect(unlink.Code).To(Equal(http.StatusOK))
		_, err = ds.UserProps(ctxA).Get("user-a", sessionKeyProperty)
		Expect(err).To(Equal(model.ErrNotFound))
		Expect(ds.UserProps(ctxA).Get("user-b", sessionKeyProperty)).To(Equal("SK-B"))
	})
})
